value.rationale: The exact first recovery step of a fourth-order graph smoothing resolvent is a natural positivity and maximum-principle invariant. The all-weight star classification is complete, reduces the full matrix decision to a unique monotone scalar equation and two least-conductive leaves, and supplies sharp attainable and singular-limit bounds with factor m-1 contrast. It additionally classifies the exact parameter range of l_infinity contractivity, not given by qualitative eventual positivity.
